Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
At Garmin we create products that are designed indoors for outdoor activities. We do this to enable our customers to make the most of their time spent pursuing their passions.
We recognize the value of flexibility in supporting employee well-being, work-life balance, and effective collaboration. Associates may work from home up to four days per month, or one day per week, while remaining connected to the teams and culture that help us do our best work.
Our roles are primarily office-based because we believe the best ideas, innovation, and strongest professional relationships are built through in-person collaboration, making regular team interaction an important part of our culture and future success.
We are a global company with offices in the US, Europe and Asia. In these centers, we carry out the various stages of product development, from initial concept to mass production of ready-to-sell units. We embrace a vertically integrated business model with strategic design, manufacturing, distribution, sales and support centers around the world to maximize our value to customers.
We are looking forward to meeting Embedded C Software Engineers, to develop software for Garmin Avionics , including performing software design, development, and testing for OEM and retrofit avionics products.
 Currently, we have openings for the following projects:
 Displays: This team develops the next generation of Garmin Integrated Flight Deck (GIFD) solutions. You will design, implement, and validate new features for advanced touchscreen flight displays, delivering intuitive and reliable functionality for Primary Flight Display (PFD), Multifunction Flight Display (MFD), Engine Indication Systems (EIS), and integrated cockpit applications.
 Team X: This team develops AXIS to add advanced capabilities while also greatly simplifying the panel installation. Next-generation flight displays. Optional built-in IFR navigation and communication functions put essential tools for flight into a single system. AXIS is available for installation in a variety of aircraft types, including experimental, light sport aircraft and certified Class I/II piston-powered aircraft.
 Requirements
Strong programming skills and knowledge of C
Experience in low-level programming
Demonstrates mastery of relevant software engineering tools (configuration management systems, build processes, debuggers, simulators, static code analysis)
Collaborate closely with product teams to integrate new features and technology into product platforms
Detail-oriented individual with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks
Strong English communication skills, both verbal and written
At least 4 years of relevant experience
BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Math or Physics or another relevant engineering/technical field
 Would be a plus
Experience in developing safety-critical software following DO-178B standard
Knowledge of Python 3, C++
A research oriented mindset
